title: 30+ years of mall world visits
content: I've been having these dreams since I was about 7 or 8 years old. The atmosphere keeps growing and I've explored a lot. It seems about as big as county. My mall doesn't seem disheveled, but there are abandoned parts on the lower level and a movie theater that's been claimed by squatters. The theater seems to be on a basement level floor. In addition to the mall there are other places, streets, gas stations, there's a fair or small theme park but I've only seen it a couple of times when I was a kid and teenager. I remember a rollercoaster. I guess the park is shut down now or? There's a hospital labyrinth. It's really confusing and frustrating in there. And it's easy to accidentally walk into a restricted area. There are strangely designed neighborhoods where all the houses are connected at the sides. If I find myself in the back yard area, there's no way to get back out without walking through a strangers house Some of the larger houses are infinite on the inside. Just rooms full of doors leading to more rooms with doors. Some of the rooms are extremely elaborately decorated and some are completely empty. Very oppressive energy in these houses.
